text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Today's our first Mejiro tea party in ages♪
I'm super happy to get to chat with everyone at our own pace~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Now then, is everybody all ready?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is it really fine to just wear casual clothes...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we don't have outside guests today.
Just being ourselves is totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe, such a heartwarming sight as always♪
Better not disturb them.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Hm, and over there is...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Tea leaves with a bright, floral aroma, or perhaps
tea leaves with a calm, subdued aroma—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
...Which one would dear sister
prefer at the moment, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, indeed, desu wa.
In order for her to enjoy it to the fullest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Hmm. They want to know what Ramonu-san's in the mood for, but don't quite know, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (In that case—it's Palmer's time to shine!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Ramonu-san.
Looks like we're gonna have another fun tea party today♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The weather's so nice, feels just like being out on the turf on a sunny day, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Though it does not sparkle
quite like the turf does.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Still... I suppose it serves well enough
as a brief respite to fuel one's burning passion for racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's nice to get a good change of pace every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
('A brief respite', huh. So that means
she's in the mood to relax, right?
Nice, that's what I wanted to know!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, sorry about that, you two!
Seriously, you're a lifesaver with the prep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
No, please pay it no mind.
We volunteered for this duty ourselves, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Speaking of which, I ran into Ramonu-san just now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We talked about how nice it'd be to relax today.
She's been running her heart out in practice lately, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —! Ah, is that so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it seems she has been pushing through strict training.
Something soothing to relieve her fatigue would be ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then, shall we go with those tea leaves with the calming aroma...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Like a single drop of white dew.
Not a bad flavor at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it pleases your palate, nothing could make me happier.
Let us enjoy our time leisurely today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having an errand, I happened to pass by near the student dorms—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much for earlier, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with that out of nowhere?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, the thought just crossed my mind. The Mejiro family truly needs your keen insight after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Come on now, stop that~
I didn't do anything that amazing, honest~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer always keeps a calm eye on her surroundings.
It seems her broad perspective proved invaluable once again today.
